name: @kiln/durable
responsibility: The one seam over Pi Durable: the gate contract (open a gate whole; a move and its completion in one commit; keyed, first move wins, never by clock), task kinds and their resume, the command ledger, one owner per store and its private local channel; the only importer of the library (src/library/), and (r14) the walk of a feature: the owner opens each next gate from the flow's data, applies a person's move, and ends a gate a feature-level move withdraws — and (r15) the record: events appended in the commit that changed the state, read back at the current version, the backbone with durable consumer cursors, the factory-log consumer, and the archive of a finished feature.
